system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 29. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (22 seconds, code score 0.92) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (cruel, smug): "You still call this a legacy?"
[b01] JULIANA (defiant, furious): "It is medicine!"
[b02] CATHERINE (smooth, patronizing): "Of course."
[b03] CATHERINE (disdainful, calculating): "Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand."
[b04] CATHERINE (icy, threatening): "The magistrate will call it witchcraft."
[b05] JULIANA (furious, shouted): "You know that is a lie!"
[b06] CATHERINE (calm, sinister): "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
[b07] JULIANA (screaming, desperate): "You cannot just destroy it!"

--- WINDOW 1 (21 seconds, code score 0.91) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (calm, sinister): "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
[b01] JULIANA (screaming, desperate): "You cannot just destroy it!"
[b02] CATHERINE (whispered, malicious): "I can burn it."
[b03] CATHERINE (chilling, relentless): "And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."
[b04] CATHERINE (cruel, resolute): "...no one will remember what was written inside."
[b05] JULIANA (enraged, defiant): "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
[b06] CATHERINE (scornful, arrogant): "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."

--- WINDOW 2 (21 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] JULIANA (desperate, weeping): "Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!"
[b01] JULIANA (pleading, agonized): "It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!"
[b02] CATHERINE (mocking, condescending): "Your mother's little book of weeds?"
[b03] CATHERINE (cruel, smug): "You still call this a legacy?"
[b04] JULIANA (defiant, furious): "It is medicine!"

--- WINDOW 3 (49 seconds, code score 0.86) ---
[b00] JULIANA (enraged, defiant): "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
[b01] CATHERINE (scornful, arrogant): "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."
[b02] CATHERINE (cold, venomous): "You were cast out once."
[b03] CATHERINE (menacing): "You should have stayed forgotten."
[b04] JULIANA (steely, resolute): "My husband will find me."
[b05] CATHERINE (scoffing, amused): "Your scarred soldier?"
[b06] CATHERINE (derisive, biting): "What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?"
[b07] GUARD (gruff, dismissive): "Move along, girl."
[b08] ACTION: The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.
[b09] JULIANA (crying out, broken): "Please!"
[b10] SFX: The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
[b11] ACTION: Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
[b12] JULIANA (sobbing, heartbroken): "Mother..."
[b13] JULIANA (desperate, shouting): "I have done nothing!"
[b14] JULIANA (screaming, hysterical): "I saved her! I healed her!"
[b15] SFX: Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.
[b16] JULIANA (shouting in anguish): "I saved the Duchess!"

Pick the single best promo.
